actions.falsifier: Development of an automated agent capable of identifying an internal logical paradox in its own base framework and initiating a valid, verified structural modification without external input or hard-coded triggers.
actions.reason: Synthesis of current project evidence shows that agentic frameworks like Popper [source-0c3114b8bfe140df] and Bayesian optimization [source-f0f5479363014d20] excel at falsification within defined bounds, while ethics-based auditing literature [source-f26a645e047847a2] highlights the continued necessity for external governance to ensure normative consistency.
actions.statement: Current automated meta-reasoning frameworks operate strictly within fixed methodological parameters and lack the reflexive capacity to autonomously revise their foundational epistemic assumptions or procedural definitions without external intervention.
